🇬🇧 Haslar in Gosport is to go from around 150 beds to 600 — one of the largest removal centres in Europe.

Residents got a consultation that closed on 6 August. Their council cannot stop it: ministers decide, not local planning.

The reported bill for this and a parallel scheme is £399m. Beds only work if removals follow.
